name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: apiKey
apiKey.description: API key. For TypeSafe Jev: your TYPESAFE_API_KEY (or leave unset to use the env var). For a local server such as Rizzo Flow: any non-empty placeholder, e.g. rizzo-local. [Default: (none) | Rizzo Flow: rizzo-local]

keepThreshold.title: keepThreshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed. [Default: 0.5]

preserveRecentMessages.title: preserveRecentMessages
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction. [Default: 6]

compactAtPercent.title: compactAtPercent
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction. [Default: 60]

minReductionRatio.title: minReductionRatio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history. [Default: 0.25]

maxStateTokens.title: maxStateTokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request. [Default: 25000 | Rizzo Flow: 12000]

maxRequestTokens.title: maxRequestTokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request. [Default: 30000 | Rizzo Flow: 14000]

maxQuestionsPerRequest.title: maxQuestionsPerRequest
maxQuestionsPerRequest.description: Questions sent in one request (two per tool call); more calls are split into several requests. Rizzo Flow accepts 64. [Default: 64 | Rizzo Flow: 64 (same)]

truncateHeadChars.title: truncateHeadChars
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note. [Default: 300]

baseUrl.title: baseUrl
baseUrl.description: System One URL. Default is the TypeSafe API; for Rizzo Flow use http://127.0.0.1:8017/v1/systemone. [Default: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone | Rizzo Flow: http://127.0.0.1:8017/v1/systemone]

model.title: model
model.description: Model name: jev-latest for TypeSafe, rizzo-latest for Rizzo Flow. [Default: jev-latest | Rizzo Flow: rizzo-latest]
